data.description: This white gold ring is engraved with the images of a mastiff and a thundercloud. It functions as a ring of protection +1. In addition, once per day, the wearer may use Summon Monster I to summon a red mastiff (use statistics for a celestial dog). Additionally, once per day the wearer may use Beast Shape I to transform into a Small red mastiff.

This white gold ring is engraved with the images of a mastiff and a thundercloud. It functions as a ring of protection +1. In addition, once per day, the wearer may use Summon Monster I to summon a red mastiff (use statistics for a celestial dog). Additionally, once per day the wearer may use Beast Shape I to transform into a Small red mastiff.
